I offer a thousand thanks to the Blessed Mother and to the Son of God for allowing me to give my testimony at this altar where Our Lady appeared at Kreupasanam.
My name is Lakshmi. I come from Thiruvalla. I have been in the Covenant since 11 January, 2023.
When I came and took the Covenant, my desire as a GNM nurse was to go abroad for work.
My friends had all come here, taken the Covenant, passed OET, and went abroad.
But in the beginning, I used to reject everything they said.
Later my friends kept telling me, and then I got opportunities to hear many testimonies. Through that, I came into faith, and I came here and took the Covenant.
After that I wrote IELTS. When I wrote IELTS, the Mother blessed me by giving me a UK score.
But even though I came here, took the Covenant, and prayed, I mostly trusted in my own merit.
When I got the UK score, I became overconfident that I would be able to go to the UK.
But maybe because the Mother saw my overconfidence, my IELTS expired today. It is still in my hand, but it became of no use.
I even got an interview. But due to the election, they suddenly banned people from India and did not issue even a single visa.
In that way, I put aside my pride—my belief in my own merit. After that, I renewed the Covenant. From then on, it was not for worldly intentions, but for spiritual intentions.
As a non-Christian, I joined the Covenant wanting to know who the Mother is, and to understand what blessings one receives when entering deeply into divine faith.
I kept the Covenant faithfully—every prayer properly, along with the Our Daily Bread prayer at 5:30 am. But I did not ask the Mother for even one worldly intention.
I only said this: “Mother, if it is Your will… whichever place You desire for me to go… only when You wish, grant me permission for it.” That was all.
I have been keeping the Covenant like this for years. After renewing it for the fifth time,
I continued in the same way—every Tuesday I attended the Father’s meditation, I did charitable works, I did everything properly. But still, I did not desire to go abroad.
After renewing the fifth Covenant, while I was sitting in a meeting, I was doing a temporary job there, in that meeting,
While sitting there, on that Tuesday, an old friend of mine—who is working abroad—sent me a message: “Don’t you want to come here?
Don’t you want to write the exam? Don’t you want to look for opportunities abroad? You have so much ability.” I replied,
“It is not about ability. I know that I have no merit at all.” Then my friend messaged me back.
After that, a doubt came to my mind: “Was it the Mother who made me feel this?” Because if this message came on a Tuesday itself,
I became afraid. Because I had no desire to trust in my own merit again. So I came before the Mother. During the time of evening prayer, I asked the Mother,
“Mother, please give me an answer. What should I do?” So, in front of the Mother, I placed everything and decided to test it by tossing a coin.
When I tossed it, it showed that the Mother wanted me to move forward. So I moved forward and took a date for the exam.
Before taking the exam date, I went and met Fr. Joseph, and I received his laying-on-of-hands prayer. With the blessing of the Father, I went for the exam.
The exam center was in Chennai. I travelled from Thiruvalla Railway Station—by train—to Chennai station.
In Chennai, in the hotel room where I stayed, I used Blessed salt and prayed, and only then I went.
Because I knew that by my own merit I would not get through the exam.
Even when I practiced the questions, it was very difficult for me. I could not even score the pass mark.
When I was going, I did not tell my husband anything. I did not tell him that when I practice I am getting such marks,
because I didn’t want him to become worried.
But I prayed and held firm faith that the Mother would come with me. Like Fr. Joseph says, “Mother who travels with us,” I believed the travelling Mother would come with me.
When I reached there and went to the exam center, I used salt and prayed. While praying,
it was a highly secured exam where nothing from outside can be taken in. But I secretly kept salt in my jeans pocket without them noticing.
I also kept a pinch of salt under my seat and on the table without them noticing. After placing it, I kept saying and saying,
I recited the Creed and said, “Mother, I don’t know anything. For my exam, Mother, You must reach here before me. I believe You have already arrived.” Saying this,
I began the exam countdown and started the system. I did not know even a single question. Out of 800 marks, we need 500 marks as the pass mark.
Even though I didn’t know any answer, I remember I started feeling sleepy and tired. After that, automatically in my mind, the options started coming—A, B, C—like that.
I marked all those options. While marking and marking,
I suddenly thought: “Which question number is this? How much time is left?” I knew nothing. “Will I get timed out? Will I fail?” When I saw the questions,
I understood clearly: it is not by my merit. Only if the Mother blesses me,
it is possible. I knew that. But while praying like this, I was also getting very sad.
While praying, I recited the Creed and said, “Mother, I cannot even see the time. On the computer I don’t know where the time is shown.
Mother, who has authority over time, please show me how much time is left.” I kept praying like that.
While I was praying, a lady wearing a grey dress came from outside the exam center and came towards me.
She was speaking in Tamil. I don’t know how to reply in Tamil. So I asked her in English, “What are you saying?” Then she pointed at my system.
When she pointed, I asked, “What is that?” When she understood that I couldn’t understand,
she took my mouse, touched it, and showed me: “You have only 20 minutes left.” Exactly when only 20 minutes were left,
that lady came near me. She also showed me that 100 questions were still remaining.
In 20 minutes, it is impossible for anyone to read and mark all those questions. And those were difficult subjects like Medical-Surgical.
In that 20 minutes, I marked the answers that came into my mind—A, B, C—and I continued.
I recited the Creed and the answers that came at that moment, those are what I marked.
After marking, I came out. In the exam center I felt deeply upset. With great sadness I stood up and said, “Mother, I entrusted everything to You and came.”
“I have no assurance at all whether I will pass this exam. After bringing me till here, will You take it back?” I asked the Mother many questions.
When I stood up, under my seat there was a jasmine flower lying there. I thought, “Who is this? A jasmine flower?” Taking the jasmine flower,
I went outside and asked the exam coordinators, “Where did this jasmine flower come from?” At that moment,
they replied, “Not even a hair article is allowed inside. If we made you remove your hair accessories,
then how did this jasmine flower come? What foolish thing are you saying?” I said,
“No, this was lying under my seat.” They replied,
“Not only hair articles—nothing at all, not even a rosary, is allowed inside. If you say something like this came under your seat,
even we don’t use hair articles, so how is it possible?” But I firmly believed the Mother came near me.
That is the sign the Mother gave me—a jasmine flower. I understood that the Mother confirmed my situation with that sign.
After that, every day I continued to attend the 5:30 Daily Bread, I prayed, and I did apostolic works.
Like this I continued. Sometimes I would tell my husband again and again, “I might fail the exam. I may not pass.” Then my husband would say,
“Don’t you believe in the Mother? If so, you will pass the exam.” One day I saw a dream.
In the dream, I saw the marks of many people, and my mark also.
Only a few people’s marks were in a white column, and all the others were in a black column.
And the mark I saw was 42—just 42. I suddenly jumped up and woke up. I checked the time—it was 3 o’clock.
When I looked, I understood: if it is 42, then it means I failed with 42 out of 800 marks—I thought I failed the exam.
In the end, I continued praying again. And then, at the end of that month, my exam result came.
The Mother gave me 542 marks and again made me a witness of her apparition. She lifted me up.
At that time, I knelt down and offered a thousand thanks to the Mother.
I didn’t know whether I was sad or happy. I felt so much love towards the Mother that I wanted to hug her.
The Mother kept drawing me closer and closer to her. After that, my processing was again delayed.
All the people who were with me went ahead. Many people’s medicals got rejected. During that time, I still came here every month—every month I would come.
Everyone mocked me: “You are a non-Christian, and still you come here every month?” But still, I came here every month.
One day I will come here and see the Mother. For me, the monthly newsletters are very important. Every month I must buy those papers. It is a very strong necessity for me.
So I used to buy every month’s papers and take them home. In October, in the paper I bought, I wrote down a date in that month of the Rosary—
I wrote a date: December 17. But even I forgot that I wrote that date.
With faith that the Mother will bless me and that one day I will be able to go abroad,
I collected all those monthly papers and kept them in that file along with my documents.
Then, after a Tuesday—suddenly I received an interview call.
I recited the Creed, prayed, and attended the interview. It was very difficult for me. The interview was extremely difficult.
But later, when I checked the calendar, I realized it was Tuesday. The interview call came exactly when I was standing outside, on a Tuesday.
Then I became sure: this interview is something the Mother gave me on Tuesday. So again I told the Mother,
“Mother, if You are the one who gave this, then give me one more sign.” On that same day itself,
the Mother gave me my visa number also. Then I became fully sure—it was the Mother who gave it.
On that Tuesday, the visa number and the interview offer letter were blessings given by the Mother. I understood clearly that it was the Mother who gave them to me.
Then the next day came the medical. Let me say this as a great miracle: I have kidney stones and uric acid issues.
Even at this young age, I face so many struggles and difficulties.
So I told the Mother, “Mother, You must reach there before me. Only then will I clear the medical.” For those who are with me,
their X-rays show patches and marks. I don’t even know if my chest X-ray has any mark.
Only when I go there will I know. So I prayed, “Mother, go everywhere before me.” I kept praying like that.
Even though I am not a Christian, I write Bible verses and pray from them.
Not by memorization. To memorize also, I write and pray. While praying like this,
the medical was in Ernakulam. I travelled to Ernakulam, along the way I prayed Rosaries. I went there.
When I entered each room, I entered with great tension. I carried salt, and like I said, I kept it secretly in my jeans pocket without them noticing.
I kept the holy oil safely inside my bag.
Then I applied the oil on my chest and entered the X-ray room. When it was time to give blood, I applied it on my hand,
and on the place where they were going to prick, and then they took the blood.
Like that, applying the oil, I entered all the medical rooms. Before entering the last room—the ECG room—I noticed something.
A lady wearing the medal like the one Fr. Joseph would give here, was entering ahead of me. She went into every room before me.
And after coming out, she would look at me and smile. Even when I entered the last vaccine room, that lady entered and came out again.
I came outside and sat down. She sat next to me and asked, “Where are you going?” I said, “Saudi.” She asked,
“Is it your first time?” I said, “Yes.” She replied, “Don’t be afraid, okay?” Then she asked, “Where is it fixed?” I said,
“It’s not fixed yet. This is the place, and this is the hospital.” Then she told me,
“Don’t be afraid. I worked there for some years earlier.” Then I looked closely at that medal she was wearing.
She asked me, “Do you go to Kreupasanam?” I said, “Yes.” Then she said,
“Don’t be afraid. The Mother will take care of everything.” After saying that, the woman stood up and left.
After that, I was sure that the Mother had confirmed it for me by giving me a sign. I had prayed and pleaded with the Mother that she should go before me.
And I firmly believed that the Mother went before me and entered and came out of every room before I did.
At 3 o’clock, my medical result came. The Mother blessed me by making me medically fit.
After that, I had to submit it for the visa.
I told the Mother, “Mother, everything for me happens on Tuesday.” So when the visa also came on a Tuesday, I became even more sure that the Mother is with me.
Finally, the digital document saying that my visa was stamped also came on a Tuesday.
This last Tuesday, I received my visa and came straight from Ernakulam directly here, to give my testimony to the Mother.
To the Mother who gave me so many blessings, I offer a thousand thanks.
As part of my charitable work, I mainly help kidney patients and cancer patients. I am someone who does field work.
When I go into the field, I get to see many cancer patients. I do whatever help I can for them.
Then, I buy the monthly newsletters and first I give it to them before giving it to anyone else, because there were many people in the field waiting to read it.
Also, Fr. Joseph says that we must do things in a special way—he says there is no use in doing something casually without prayer or meditation.
One day I thought about this while listening to testimonies.
I decided to write the Apparition prayer, pin it on every paper, and place my hand on it and pray.
I pinned it on every paper and I used to take it everywhere and give it.
Like that, I continued my apostolic mission.
I also give financial help to patients—kidney patients and others. Even if it is only a small help that I can do,
I used to do it online by asking people I know.
And the greatest grace I received through the Covenant is that I was able to forgive my enemies. I used to behave with deep hatred in my heart.
To everyone who treated me badly, I used to behave the same way. But I changed a lot from that. I was able to humble myself before them,
talk to them, send them messages, and call them. The Mother gave me the grace to do that.
Even towards my parents and towards everyone, the Mother gave me compassion. Towards anyone—no matter who it is—the Mother gave me repentance,
compassion, and even guilt when I do something wrong. She gave me all those graces.
A thousand thanks to the Mother. I pray that the Mother will bless me to give more testimonies.
“Lord, how abundant are Your blessings! You have stored them up for those who fear You; You openly give them to those who take refuge in You.” Psalm 31:19.
Through the Covenant, Covenant children love and honor God, and they try to live according to His will.
From the abundance of blessings that God has prepared for His children, He gives to us. The goodness of God is immeasurable.
And His love is beyond our calculations and expectations—an infinite love. This is the work of God that we share with others through Covenant testimonies.
From the testimony of this daughter, Lakshmi S. Kumar, this is what we understand,
Lord, You have prepared Your blessings for Your devotees. The blessings prepared by God are what this daughter has now testified to, standing in this holy place where the Blessed Mother appeared.
At first, when her friends spoke to her, she did not believe. Later she came here, took the Covenant, and prayed.
After writing IELTS, she received the UK score. She had good confidence—perhaps overconfidence.
Then Jesus and the Mother held her hand and led her into a humble life.
Later, she desired to leave all worldly intentions and live a spiritual life. She moved from her own will to the Mother’s will.
She desired to live according to God’s will and to live her Covenant life with devotion. Leaving behind all the matters of worldly life, she slowly decided to move forward.
When she renewed the Covenant the fifth time, she fixed the date for the next exam. She prayed, and the exam was in Chennai.
On the way to the exam, she prayed continuously.
But when she reached there, it was as if all hopes were falling—the exam was very difficult. Yet, we can hear only one prayer from this daughter in every situation,
“Mother, You must go before me.”
We can again and again see that she was able to recognize the presence of Jesus and the Mother in every place.
Even when she stood up after writing the exam, the jasmine flower being there was also a sign.
Later, when she went for the medical test also, the presence of the Mother was felt very strongly. Whenever this daughter prayed, saying, “Mother, You must go before me,”
the Mother and Jesus were with her. Even though there were many complications in the medical test, when she prayed to Jesus and the Mother—when she prayed, “Go before me,”
the Mother went before her in the form of a woman and spoke to her: “Don’t you go to Kreupasanam? Pray. Don’t be afraid.”
It is in the lives of Covenant children that we can understand more deeply the presence of Jesus and His Mother.
When we pray with faith—as we heard in the Psalm—it says the Lord has poured out blessings and prepared blessings for His devotees.
When we take refuge in Jesus, it is an experience where Jesus and the Mother stand with us. This is something we see specially in the lives of Covenant children.
She also said something about "doing special", whenever she gave the monthly paper to others, along with that paper she pinned the “Apparition Prayer”
written by her own hand. This is what she did in a special way.
Fr. Joseph always says, “We must increase our spiritual wealth. If we can do something in a special way, we should do it.” This daughter did exactly that.
And because of that, she received more blessings of Jesus. When she surrendered herself completely and lived according to the will of Jesus—
when she submitted and just surrendered—then Jesus and the Mother opened a great new path in her life.
In the Covenant life, she lived a humble life—a prayerful life, a devotional life, a life of faith.
That life helped her to forgive others, to repent, and to receive blessings through repentance.
She studied Bible verses, prayed, and she was always able to recognize the presence of the Pilgrim Mother in her life. This became her spiritual treasure.
In other words, when she became spiritually humble and lowly, only then could Jesus and the Mother enter more deeply into her life.
Even if we have many difficulties in our life, we too can pray with faith, believing that Jesus and the Mother are with us,
and that everything is being done and prepared for our good.
Let us also pray. Let us also depend on God and live the Covenant life with devotion. Let us strengthen the great goodness that God has already prepared,
and strengthen our faith by trusting in Him.
Let us pray that we may experience the protection of the Blessed Mother, who appeared alive, in our own life too.
For all the blessings received by Lakshmi S. Kumar and her family, let us clap our hands and glorify God.
Jesus, thank You. Jesus, praise You.
